entries.title: Axiom Shift
entries.description: A one-button rhythm runner where the beat is something you see, not hear — a visible pulse you read instead of music, so it plays in a silent classroom and works for a deaf pupil. You never lose — a touch smudges and rewinds to the last checkpoint, and your furthest progress is always kept. Offline, no accounts, no sound.
